morphology.pattern_note: 按外来称谓整词处理，无马来语词缀交替；IPA 为英语词典所载 saheb 变体读音，不代表已核实的马来语规范读音。

senses.zh_definition: 南亚语境中对男子的尊称，相当于“先生”或“大人”；殖民时期也常用于称呼欧洲官员。为 sahib 的异体拼写。
senses.en_definition: A variant of sahib, a respectful title or form of address for a man in South Asian usage, historically often a European official.
senses.ms_definition: Sapaan atau gelaran hormat bagi lelaki dalam konteks Asia Selatan, termasuk pegawai Eropah pada zaman penjajahan; bentuk varian bagi sahib.
senses.nuances: [Collins 英语词典](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/sahib)收录 saheb 为 sahib 的变体。DBP 可核实的相关词头是 sahib，释义涉及物主及朋友、盟友，不能直接移植为 saheb 的已认证马来语义项。参见 [DBP：sahib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sahib)。目前无法确认输入拼写的正式马来语词头身份，故标为 unverified；本条马来语释义为说明性编写。下列为南亚称谓组合，未经马来语语料频率验证。

collocations.en: the form of address Collector Saheb

etymology.historical_story: Saheb is a variant of sahib. English dictionaries trace sahib through Urdu to Arabic ṣāḥib, associated with companionship and possession. In South Asian usage, it developed into a respectful male title and became prominent in colonial forms of address. Malay also records the related spelling sahib, but that does not establish saheb as a standard Malay headword. [Collins: sahib and saheb](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/sahib); [DBP: sahib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=sahib).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“萨—赫布”：想象旧电影中有人恭敬地叫一声“Saheb，先生！”把声音与尊称场景一起记住。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在马来西亚一般交往中，不把 saheb 当作通用礼貌称呼。可按关系与场合使用 Encik、Tuan 或对方认可的正式头衔。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合保留在历史引文、南亚称谓及文学讨论中。引用时尊重原文拼写；避免模仿口音或借殖民时代的上下级称谓取笑他人。
